en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 7.  Once  a  group  of  people  were  present  before  Amirul Momineen  (a.s.)  when  the  narrator  asked,  “What  is  your opinion about Qadiriya?” Imam asked, “Is there any Qadiri with you or in this house?” The narrator asked, “What will you  tell  them?”  Imam  (a.s.)  replied,  “I  will  ask  them  to repent and if they do not repent, I will behead them.”
